**`q < 2,000` — unchanged.** V5 has passed a **manual mathematical
audit with exact computational checks**. This is not formal verification.

**[Download the corrected eleven-page proof](https://github.com/twinheterodox/tenth-discriminant/releases/download/v0.5.1/tenth-discriminant-v0.5.1.pdf)** ·
**[Download the source and verification bundle](https://github.com/twinheterodox/tenth-discriminant/releases/download/v0.5.1/tenth-discriminant-v0.5.1.zip)**

This patch applies the audit's one minor wording correction in §6.2.
With `S = floor(R/110)`, the paper now explicitly uses

$$
\frac{\log R}{S}\le 110.001\frac{\log R}{R}
\le 110.001\frac{\log M}{M}<0.00004,
\qquad R\ge M=50{,}000{,}000.
$$

The function `(log R)/R` decreases on this range; `(log R)/S` increases
between floor jumps. The certificate already uses the correct upper
bound. Its calculations, constants, and numerical results are unchanged.
The only program-output change is the final review-status sentence.

The reported audit applies to v0.5.0 with this correction. Codex applied
the correction and checked its scope; no separate audit of the patch
release is claimed. The two relevant exact inequalities were confirmed,
and the PDF was rebuilt, rendered, and visually inspected. All 37
arithmetic-check results, 62,880 determinant cases, 10,000 primitive-norm
coefficient comparisons, and the exhaustive finite check are retained.
The full suite was not rerun for this wording patch.
